audit.title: Apollo CPT single-page alignment audit
audit.method: sequential, one CPT at a time

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Namespace drift: mockups annotate _ap_* keys that do not exist; production uses _event_*/_dj_*/_local_*
MASTER_REGISTRY violated by all three (direct register_post_meta); event meta double-registered in apollo-core/config/meta.php AND apollo-events/Registry.php with drift
Metabox coverage uneven: event comprehensive, location strong, DJ wp-admin severely under-built (11 fields)
Live debug artifact: single-event.php file_put_contents debug-e031aa.log on every render + echoed version marker (universe V-02)

findings.finding: live agent-log file_put_contents(debug-e031aa.log) per render + echoed HTML version marker
lineup badge collected in render JSON + read by lineup.php but stripped on save (only dj_id/start_time/end_time persisted)
_event_ticket_btn_style/_event_list_btn_style read by orchestrator, no metabox field
venue.php falls back to Rio-center coords; mockup hides map when coords absent
_event_budget in core config only (gestor-owned); earlybird/lista keys only in apollo-events Registry

event.data_path_security: solid: nonce + autosave guard + current_user_can(edit_post) + per-type sanitize; escaping consistent; only defect is debug log

findings.finding: wp-admin metabox exposes 11 keys; bandcamp/booking/media_kit/long-bio/set-mix-url/sounds/facebook/twitter/tiktok/beatport/RA/gallery only settable via frontend self-edit form
mockup tracks[] repeater degrades to single _dj_set_url/_dj_mix_url + SoundCloud shelf; no per-track title/meta/url authoring
_dj_gallery read by dj-v3/gallery.php but not registered or editable
no distinct about-photo; mockup requires aboutPhoto != hero, production only has _dj_image + _dj_banner
booking richer than mockup: real form + _dj_booking_nonce vs mockup mailto
confirm _dj_user_id and _dj_booking are show_in_rest=false (DJsController has 5 public __return_true routes)

dj.data_path_security: solid but narrow: nonce + autosave + cap + sanitize; risk is coverage + REST exposure of _dj_user_id

findings.finding: _local_amenities and _local_hours read by single-local.php but no metabox field; amenities section unauthorable
production collects+renders _local_capacity/_local_price_range; mockup explicitly forbids capacity/lotacao by design philosophy
no marquee repeater; _ap_marquee_tags derived from _local_types/_local_areas taxonomies
best core-data alignment: address/geo/contact fully authored; gallery via LocalSchema (<=5 attached media)

local.data_path_security: consistent nonce+cap+sanitize via MetaboxSaver; LocalSchema bounds gallery to 5; escaping consistent

P2_data_entry_compliance: build out DJ wp-admin metabox (bandcamp/booking/media_kit/long-bio/set-mix/sounds/socials/about-photo) or document frontend form as SSOT
add DJ _dj_tracks repeater or accept single-URL degradation
add loc _local_amenities + _local_hours fields or stop reading them
fix event lineup badge in Metabox::save()
P3_registry_namespace: consolidate meta registration into apollo-core (remove event double-registration)
reconcile _ap_* mockup annotations with real keys
remove orphan reads or add fields (event btn_style, dj gallery)
P4_design_doctrine: resolve loc capacity conflict (drop from render or amend philosophy)
align event venue map fallback with graceful-hide law
